subject: english
prompt: 中翻英：我哥哥每星期三放學後參加音樂社。

options.text: My brother join the music club after school every Wednesday.
My brother is joining the music club yesterday after school.
My brother joins the music club after school every Wednesday.
Every Wednesday the music club join my brother after school.

answer.explanation: Every Wednesday marks a repeated habit. My brother is third-person singular, so join becomes joins; after school and every Wednesday preserve when he attends.

solutionStrategy: 先鎖定主詞與習慣時間，再補第三人稱單數字尾，最後依「參加什麼／何時」排列訊息。
solutionSteps: 找出主詞「我哥哥」，英文是 My brother，屬第三人稱單數。
「每星期三」表示習慣，選現在簡單式。
將 join 改為 joins，並保留受詞 the music club。
把 after school 和 every Wednesday 放在句尾交代時間。
選 C；A 少了 -s，B 時間不合，D 把社團誤當動作者。
